The [[Elusive Black Moa]] is a [[Black Moa]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Mourning Veil Falls]] during the [[Norn Catering]] quest.

To find it, start from [[Durheim Archives]]. It will lead you on a short chase before turning hostile. Be prepared to encounter popup [[Warden]] groups along the way.
